violation_type.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))
violation_type.short_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was missing training for the previous training year in the following topics:  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome,  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS),  Understanding early childhood brain development.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver was missing training for the previous training year in the following topics:  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome,  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS),  Understanding early childhood brain development.
The primary caregiver did not have SIDS, shaken baby, early brain development training.
One employee file was evaluated. File was missing training certificate on SIDS and Baby shaken syndrome.
At time of inspection, operation did not have current SIDS, understanding early childhood brain development or shaken baby syndrome training, last training certificate date 12.1.21.
Although caregiver does have thirty annual hours of training she is missing training for recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome, understanding early childhood brain development

The primary caregiver did not have current training in recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome,   understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS),  and  understanding early childhood brain development.
